author: Ft Worth Times
title: Nate Schatzline reflects on election outcomes and religious themes in November posts
text:
Nate Schatzline, a Republican elected to the Texas State House in 2023 to represent the state’s 93rd House district, posted several comments on social media on November 5, 2025, addressing recent political developments and election outcomes.
In an initial response regarding Mamdani’s apparent victory, Schatzline referenced scripture: “3 For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear. 4 They” (posted November 5, 2025).
Later that evening, he commented on early voting results in the Tarrant County SD 9 race: “EV in Tarrant County SD 9 race tells us 3 things:
1. @LeighForTexas ran one heck of a campaign! Well done my friend! She will be our next state senator.
2. SD9 has no appetite for casinos.
3. Republicans have work to do for the midterms, & we will step up.” (posted November 5, 2025).
In another post later that night, Schatzline reflected on broader cultural and religious themes: “We’ve come a long way. The Lord can still save New York. But it’s going to take a BOLD Church, Pastors with a backbone, & a spiritual revival.” (posted November 5, 2025).
Schatzline succeeded Matt Krause as representative for Texas’ 93rd House district after his election in 2023.
